label: CONNECTION

cover.headline: 5 questions to ask each other *before the year ends*

points.heading: What was our best moment?
points.body: Start with the good. It sets a warm tone.
points.panel: “What was your favorite moment of ours this year?”

points.heading: What was hard?
points.body: Naming hard times together makes them lighter.
points.panel: “What was the hardest part of this year for you?”

points.heading: What did we handle well?
points.body: Celebrate the ways you showed up for each other.
points.panel: “When did you feel we were a good team?”

points.heading: What do we want more of?
points.body: Look ahead with hope, not resolutions.
points.panel: “What would you like more of next year, for us?”

points.heading: What can I do for you?
points.panel: “Is there one thing I could do that would really help you next year?”

close.save: Save this for a quiet evening.

caption:
The end of the year is a natural moment to pause and look back, together.

These five questions help you remember the good, name the hard, and choose what you want more of next year. Pour a drink, put your phones away, and take your time. There are no wrong answers.

Save this for a quiet evening, and follow @spotseason for more small steps.
